# BASS Android

The official Java API and ARM64 libraries are copied without modification from
Un4seen's Android archives. `sources.json` records the URLs, archive SHA-256 and
each packaged file's SHA-256. All seven binaries support 16 KB memory pages.

BASS 2.4.18.3; BASSALAC 2.4.1; BASSAPE 2.4.1; BASSWV 2.4.7.4;
BASSFLAC 2.4.6.1; BASSOPUS 2.4.3.3; BASSDSD 2.4.2.

The official `*.txt` notices are included here and in the application's offline
license viewer. BASS is proprietary and is free only for non-commercial use by
non-commercial entities, with no revenue including advertising. Commercial use
requires an Un4seen license. These binaries are not relicensed under the
application GPL license. Plugin and underlying codec notices remain applicable.

Verify without compiling: `python3 tools/verify_media_vendor.py`.
